title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.11.0 adds Week 1.3, a reproducible CPU optimizer laboratory and an 18-page lecture. Students compare Momentum, Adam, L-BFGS and staged optimization across four analytic profiles on matched data, then test SOAP and self-scaled Broyden on a fifth profile with rising frequency. The notebook includes fixed splits, a matched evaluation budget, signed errors, and six exercises. The deep-cavity optimizer sequence is tested on a small regression problem. The broader course covers continuum and rarefied CFD, reduced-order modeling, physics-informed neural networks, neural operators, computer vision, and attention and language-modeling laboratories. Case-specific data licenses and scientific limitations are documented in the repository.
